name: CARBOplatin + Pemetrexed (NSCLC, non-squamous)
cyclesNote: 4 cycles as a platinum doublet per NSCL-F line 4809; pemetrexed continuation maintenance may follow in the metastatic setting per clinical review

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic carboplatin/pemetrexed doublet, typically chosen for patients who are not candidates for cisplatin. Pemetrexed is restricted to NON-squamous NSCLC. For NSCLC without an actionable oncogenic driver: driver-positive disease (EGFR/ALK/ROS1/etc.) is directed to targeted therapy first-line. Broad molecular profiling and PD-L1 testing recommended before first-line therapy. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, NSCL-E (Useful in Certain Circumstances: Carboplatin/Pemetrexed, nonsquamous).

histology: non-squamous (adenocarcinoma, large cell carcinoma, or NSCLC not otherwise specified); NOT for squamous cell carcinoma (pemetrexed is restricted to non-squamous histology)

premedications.name: Pemetrexed supplementation
premedications.notes: folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation started before pemetrexed; dexamethasone premedication to reduce rash, per pemetrexed labeling.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: carboplatin-based regimen; give moderate emetic-risk antiemetic prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: antiemetics: carboplatin-based regimen is moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis on day of treatment
pemetrexed: folic acid + vitamin B12 + dexamethasone premedication
carboplatin dosed to target AUC (Calvert formula) using measured or estimated GFR
monitoring: CBC before each cycle - carboplatin causes thrombocytopenia
renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle (drives AUC dosing)
adequate folic acid / B12 supplementation for pemetrexed

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Hold or reduce per protocol-specific hematologic criteria; physician decides.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F line 4809 (Carboplatin AUC 5 Day 1). Target AUC dosed by Calvert formula (basis auc, unit AUC, dosePerUnit is the target AUC). ISMP tall-man (CARBOplatin).

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: NSCL-F 1 of 2 (Concurrent Chemoradiation Regimens, nonsquamous): Carboplatin AUC 5 on Day 1, Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 on Day 1 every 21 days for 4 cycles (line 4809)

drugs.name: Pemetrexed
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F line 4809 (Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 Day 1). Non-squamous histology only. Requires folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation plus dexamethasone premedication per pemetrexed labeling.

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
